mapper.insert: INSERT INTO trace_events (trace_id, tenant_id, project_id, key_id, segment, name, status, latency_ms, payload, created_at) VALUES (#{traceId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{tenantId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{projectId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{keyId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{segment,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{name,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{status,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{latencyMs,jdbcType=BIGINT}, CAST(#{payload,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS JSONB), #{createdAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP})
mapper.select: SELECT id, trace_id, tenant_id, project_id, key_id, segment, name, status, latency_ms, CAST(payload AS VARCHAR) AS payload, created_at FROM trace_events WHERE trace_id = #{traceId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ORDER BY id ASC
